सूची I (पहल / निकाय)
A. SOAR पहल
B. सीबीएसई पाठ्यक्रम
C. एनसीईआरटी पहल
D. दीक्षा (DIKSHA) प्लेटफॉर्म

सूची II (प्रमुख एआई विशेषता / विवरण)
1. कक्षा VI से 15 घंटे का एआई कौशल मॉड्यूल और कक्षा IX-XII में वैकल्पिक विषय प्रदान करता है
2. कक्षा 1-2 की पाठ्यपुस्तकों का 22 भारतीय भाषाओं में अनुवाद करने के लिए AI/ML का उपयोग किया गया
3. इसमें तीन 15 घंटे के छात्र मॉड्यूल और एक 45 घंटे का 'एआई फॉर एजुकेटर्स' शिक्षक मॉड्यूल शामिल है

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding initiatives integrating AI in Indian school education:

List I (Initiative / Body)
A. SOAR Initiative
B. CBSE Curriculum
C. NCERT Initiative
D. DIKSHA Platform

List II (Key AI Feature / Description)
1. Offers a 15-hour AI skill module from Class VI onwards and an optional subject in Classes IX–XII
2. AI/ML utilized to translate Grade 1–2 textbooks into 22 Indian languages
3. Features three 15-hour student modules and one 45-hour 'AI for Educators' teacher module
4. Provides read-aloud feature for visually impaired students and AI-based keyword search in videos

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the official document on AI in Education: SOAR launched by MSDE includes three 15-hour student modules and one 45-hour 'AI for Educators' teacher module (A-3). CBSE offers a 15-hour AI skill module from Class VI onwards and AI as an optional subject in Classes IX-XII (B-1). NCERT used AI/ML to translate Grade 1-2 textbooks into 22 Indian languages (C-2). DIKSHA uses AI for inclusivity via an AI-based keyword search in videos and a read-aloud feature for visually impaired students (D-4).
questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा में एआई पर आधिकारिक दस्तावेज़ के अनुसार: एमएसडीई द्वारा शुरू की गई SOAR पहल में तीन 15 घंटे के छात्र मॉड्यूल और एक 45 घंटे का 'एआई फॉर एजुकेटर्स' शिक्षक मॉड्यूल शामिल है (A-3)। सीबीएसई कक्षा VI से 15 घंटे का एआई कौशल मॉड्यूल और कक्षा IX-XII में वैकल्पिक विषय प्रदान करता है (B-1)। एनसीईआरटी ने कक्षा 1-2 की पाठ्यपुस्तकों का 22 भारतीय भाषाओं में अनुवाद करने के लिए AI/ML का उपयोग किया (C-2)। दीक्षा वीडियो में एआई-आधारित कीवर्ड खोज और दृष्टिबाधित छात्रों के लिए रीड-अलाउड सुविधा प्रदान करती है (D-4)।
key_facts: Currently, CBSE offers a 15 -hour AI skill module from Class VI onwards and AI as an optional subject in Classes IX -XII . NCERT has incorporated AI content in Class XI Computer Science and Informatics Practices textbooks and used AI/ML to translate Grade 1 -2 textbooks into 22 Indian languages.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the AI landscape and talent pipeline in India:

1. In 2024, 89% of new startups were AI-powered, and 87% of enterprises were actively employing AI.
2. According to NASSCOM, India needs over 1.25 million AI professionals by 2027 at a 15% CAGR to support its market growth.
3. The IndiaAI Mission was launched in March 2024 to make India a global AI leader by fostering innovation.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are factually correct as per the official report: In 2024, 89% of new startups were AI-powered and 87% of enterprises actively employed AI. To support growth, India needs over 1.25 million AI professionals by 2027 at a 15% CAGR (NASSCOM). The IndiaAI Mission was launched in March 2024 to foster innovation across government, institutions, startups, private sector, and academia.
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं: 2024 में, 89% नए स्टार्टअप एआई-संचालित थे और 87% उद्यम सक्रिय रूप से एआई का उपयोग कर रहे थे। विकास को गति देने के लिए, NASSCOM के अनुसार भारत को 15% सीएजीआर पर 2027 तक 1.25 मिलियन से अधिक एआई पेशेवरों की आवश्यकता है। मार्च 2024 में इंडिया एआई मिशन शुरू किया गया था।
key_facts: In 2024, 89% of new startups were AI -powered, and 87% of the enterprises are actively employing AI. This is just the beginning – the Indian AI market is expected to grow at a rate of 25% -35% through 2027. To support this growth, India, which had an AI talent pool of 600,000 -650,000 in 2024, needs over 1.25 million AI professionals by 2027, at a 15% CAGR, according to NASSCOM.

questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding the roles and potential applications of AI in the education sector is NOT correctly matched according to the Yojana Synopsis?
options_english: Educator secondary tasks : Grading activities, handling routine and repetitive paperwork, and logistics-related matters
Hyper-personalisation : Developing student specific learning profiles based on ability, preferred mode of learning and experience

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the integration of Artificial Intelligence in school education:

Statement I: The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 emphasises the importance of AI-learning across all educational levels.
Statement II: Currently, CBSE offers Artificial Intelligence as an optional subject in Classes IX–XII.

Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
options_english: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. The NEP 2020 explicitly emphasises the importance of AI-learning across all educational levels. questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। एनईपी 2020 स्पष्ट रूप से सभी शैक्षिक स्तरों पर एआई-लर्निंग के महत्व पर जोर देती है। इसके अलावा, शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने स्कूलों में एआई को एकीकृत किया है, जिसके तहत सीबीएसई वर्तमान में कक्षा IX-XII में वैकल्पिक विषय के रूप में एआई की पेशकश करता है।
key_facts: The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 recogni ses AI's potential for economic growth, solving educational challenges, enhancing teacher capabilities, and personali sing learning – and emphasises the importance of AI -learning across all educational levels .

questions.question_hindi:
सीबीएसई एआई एकीकरण मैनुअल और भारत की एआई रणनीति के आधार पर निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. भारत की एआई रणनीति एआई की क्षमता का दोहन करने के लिए कौशल-आधारित शिक्षा के विपरीत ज्ञान-गहन (knowledge-intensive) शिक्षा के महत्व की पहचान करती है।
2. आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस को एक संज्ञानात्मक विज्ञान (कॉग्निटिव साइंस) माना जाता है जिसका विकास गणित, दर्शनशास्त्र, समाजशास्त्र और कंप्यूटिंग जैसे विषयों से हुआ है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements based on the CBSE AI Integration Manual and India's AI Strategy:

1. India’s AI Strategy identifies the importance of knowledge-intensive education as opposed to skills-based education to harness the potential of AI.
2. Artificial Intelligence is considered a Cognitive Science whose evolution has grown out of disciplines such as Mathematics, Philosophy, Sociology, and Computing.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statement 1 is incorrect because India’s AI Strategy identifies the importance of skills-based education (as opposed to knowledge-intensive education), and the value of project-related work. Statement 2 is correct as AI is defined as a Cognitive Science derived from disciplines like Science, Mathematics, Philosophy, Sociology, Computing, and others.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि भारत की एआई रणनीति ज्ञान-गहन शिक्षा के विपरीत 'कौशल-आधारित शिक्षा' (skills-based education) के महत्व और परियोजना-संबंधी कार्य के मूल्य की पहचान करती है। कथन 2 सही है क्योंकि एआई को एक संज्ञानात्मक विज्ञान माना जाता है जो विज्ञान, गणित, दर्शनशास्त्र, समाजशास्त्र, कंप्यूटिंग आदि से विकसित हुआ है।
key_facts: The report also identifies the importance of skills-based education ( as opposed to knowledge intensive education), and the value of project related work in order to “effectively harness the potential of AI in a sustainable manner”

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding key historical milestones and platforms in Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIEd):

List I (System / Milestone / Platform)
A. PLATO
B. LISP Tutor
C. International AIED Society
D. ELIZA

List II (Associated Institution / Origin / Year)
1. Evaluated in a mini-course in the fall of 1984 at Carnegie Mellon University
2. Computer-based instruction system developed in the 1960s by the University of Illinois
3. Founded in 1993 comprising researchers in computer science, education, and psychology
4. Early chatbot starting in 1966 with an emulator responding to user inputs

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english:
According to the provided text:
- PLATO was developed in the 1960s by the University of Illinois (A-2).
- The LISP Tutor was evaluated in a Carnegie Mellon University mini-course in the fall of 1984 (B-1).
- The International Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED) Society was founded in 1993 (C-3).
- ELIZA is an early chatbot timeline milestone starting in 1966 (D-4).
questions.explanation_hindi:
दिए गए संदर्भ के अनुसार:
- PLATO को 1960 के दशक में इलिनोइस विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा विकसित किया गया था (A-2)।
- LISP Tutor का मूल्यांकन 1984 के अंत में कार्नेगी मेलन विश्वविद्यालय के लघु-पाठ्यक्रम में किया गया था (B-1)।
- इंटरनेशनल आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस इन एजुकेशन (AIED) सोसाइटी की स्थापना 1993 में हुई थी (C-3)।
- ELIZA 1966 से शुरू होने वाला प्रारंभिक चैटबॉट मील का पत्थर है (D-4)।
key_facts:
In the 1960s, educators and researchers began developing computer-based instruction systems, such as PLATO, developed by the University of Illinois. [3] 

In the 1970s, AI techniques were added to computer-assisted instruction (CAI) to form intelligent tutoring systems. The LISP Tutor was evaluated in a Carnegie Mellon University mini-course in the fall of 1984. [4] [5] 

The International Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED) Society was founded in 1993, [6] and comprised researchers with backgrounds in computer science, education, and psychology. [7]

1. अध्ययनों के एक दशक की 2019 की समीक्षा से पता चला कि अधिकांश शोधों ने शैक्षणिक एकीकरण की तुलना में तकनीकी डिजाइन को प्राथमिकता दी।

1. A 2019 review of a decade of studies revealed that most research prioritized technological design over pedagogical integration.
2. The International AIED Society was founded in 1993 and produces the International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education (IJAIED).

Which of the statements given above are correct?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements based on the Yojana Synopsis regarding the opportunities and applications of Artificial Intelligence in the education sector:

Statement I: AI-enabled hyper-personalisation assists in developing student-specific learning profiles and customised learning environments based on ability, mode of learning, and experience.
Statement II: AI systems can assist educators with secondary tasks such as grading activities, routine paperwork, and logistics-related matters.

Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
options_english: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct according to the Yojana Synopsis. Firstly, AI-enabled hyper-personalisation helps in developing student specific learning profiles and customised learning environments based on ability, preferred mode of learning, and experience. Thirdly, AI systems can assist educators with secondary tasks such as grading activities, handling routine paperwork, and logistics-related matters.
questions.explanation_hindi: योजना सिनॉप्सिस के अनुसार दोनों कथन सही हैं। पहला, AI-सक्षम हाइपर-वैयक्तिकरण छात्र-विशिष्ट शिक्षण प्रोफाइल और क्षमता, पसंदीदा मोड और अनुभव के आधार पर अनुकूलित शिक्षण वातावरण विकसित करने में सहायता करता है। तीसरा, AI प्रणालियाँ शिक्षकों को ग्रेडिंग गतिविधियों, नियमित कागजी कार्रवाई और रसद-संबंधी मामलों जैसे माध्यमिक कार्यों में सहायता कर सकती हैं।
key_facts: Firstly, Al-enabled hyper-personalisation helps in developing student specific learning profiles and in developing customised learning environments based on ability, preferred mode of learning and experience. • Secondly, the use of smart assistants (Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Siri, and Microsoft Cortana) and associated technologies offer significant potential to help students. • Thirdly, AI systems can assist educators with secondary tasks such as grading activities, providing personalised responses to students, handling routine and repetitive paperwork and dealing with logistics-related matters.

questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding findings from the surveys conducted for the IISc Committee Report on Emerging AI Tools for Education and Research (2024):

List I (Survey Category / Group)
A. Faculty Survey on Assessment Adaptation
B. Faculty Survey on Research Writing
C. Student Survey on Major Plus Points
D. Student Survey on Least Helpful Aspects

List II (Report Finding / Response)
1. Paraphrasing and rewriting material for clarity
2. Logical reasoning, problem-solving, or mathematical proofs
3. Acceptable for grammar and stylistic corrections
4. Switching from unproctored take-home exams to in-class exams

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english: Based on the IISc report: Some faculty members switched from unproctored, take-home exams to in-class exams (A-4). Faculty members find the use of AI tools acceptable for grammar and stylistic corrections to research writing (B-3). Students considered paraphrasing and rewriting material for clarity as major plus points (C-1), whereas logical reasoning, problem-solving, or mathematical proofs were considered the least helpful aspects (D-2).
questions.explanation_hindi: आईआईएससी रिपोर्ट के अनुसार: कुछ संकाय सदस्यों ने अनप्रोक्टर्ड, टेक-होम परीक्षाओं से कक्षा में होने वाली परीक्षाओं पर स्विच किया (A-4)। संकाय सदस्य शोध लेखन में व्याकरण और शैलीगत सुधारों के लिए एआई उपकरणों के उपयोग को स्वीकार्य पाते हैं (B-3)। छात्रों ने स्पष्टता के लिए सामग्री को दोबारा लिखने/पैराफ्रेज़िंग को प्रमुख प्लस पॉइंट माना (C-1), जबकि तार्किक तर्क, समस्या-समाधान या गणितीय प्रमाणों को सबसे कम मददगार माना (D-2)।
key_facts: Some faculty members have switched from unproctored, take-home exams to in-class exams. Others have modified their assignments and tests so that AI tools are unlikely to affect assessment... faculty members appear to find the use of AI tools acceptable for grammar and stylistic corrections to research writing... In general, paraphrasing and rewriting material for clarity were considered the major plus points, whereas logical reasoning, problem-solving, or mathematical proofs were considered the least helpful aspects of AI tools.

questions.question_hindi:
भारतीय स्कूली शिक्षा में कम्प्यूटेशनल थिंकिंग (CT) और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) के एकीकरण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. एनसीईआरटी ने सीबीएसई के सहयोग से शैक्षणिक वर्ष 2026-27 से कक्षा III से VIII के लिए एक समर्पित कम्प्यूटेशनल थिंकिंग और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस पाठ्यक्रम शुरू किया है।
2. यह पाठ्यचर्या ढांचा जानबूझकर कम्प्यूटेशनल थिंकिंग को मूलभूत क्षमता के रूप में स्थापित करता है जिस पर एआई शिक्षा का निर्माण किया गया है।
3. आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस और संबद्ध विषयों में कक्षा 9-12 के लिए पाठ्यक्रम को अंतिम रूप दे दिया गया है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the integration of Computational Thinking (CT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Indian school education:

1. NCERT in collaboration with CBSE has introduced a dedicated Computational Thinking and Artificial Intelligence Curriculum for Classes III to VIII from the academic year 2026-27.
2. The curriculum framework deliberately positions Computational Thinking as the foundational competency upon which AI learning is built.
3. The curriculum for grades 9–12 in Artificial Intelligence and allied subjects has been finalized.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct based on the PIB release. NCERT in collaboration with CBSE introduced a dedicated CT and AI Curriculum for Classes III to VIII from 2026-27, the curriculum for grades 9-12 has been finalized, and Computational Thinking is deliberately positioned as the foundational competency upon which AI learning is built.
questions.explanation_hindi: पीआईबी विज्ञप्ति के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं। एनसीईआरटी ने सीबीएसई के सहयोग से शैक्षणिक वर्ष 2026-27 से कक्षा III से VIII के लिए समर्पित सीटी और एआई पाठ्यक्रम शुरू किया है, कक्षा 9-12 के पाठ्यक्रम को अंतिम रूप दे दिया गया है, और कम्प्यूटेशनल थिंकिंग को जानबूझकर उस मूलभूत क्षमता के रूप में स्थापित किया गया है जिस पर एआई शिक्षण आधारित है।
key_facts: Accordingly, NCERT in collaboration with Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has introduced a dedicated Computational Thinking and Artificial Intelligence Curriculum for Classes III to VIII from the academic year 2026-27. Curriculum for grade 9-12 in Artificial Intelligence and allied subjects has been finalized. This curriculum focuses on fostering logical reasoning, pattern recognition, algorithm design, and data literacy, while also emphasizing the importance of responsible and ethical AI. By integrating problem-solving, creativity, and innovation, the framework deliberately positions Computational Thinking as the foundational competency upon which AI learning is built, ensuring a meaningful and age-appropriate progression across grades.

questions.question_hindi:
एआई और गणित पर राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (एनईपी) 2020 की सिफारिशों के आधार पर निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?

कथन I गलत है, लेकिन कथन II सही है
न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements based on the recommendations of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 on AI and Mathematics:

Statement I: Under para 4.25, NEP 2020 recommends that activities involving coding will be introduced in the Middle Stage.
Statement II: Mathematics and computational thinking will be given increased emphasis throughout the school years, starting only from the Preparatory Stage rather than the Foundational Stage.

Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
options_english: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct
Neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct
Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect
questions.explanation_english: Statement I is correct: NEP 2020 recommends that 'Activities involving coding will be introduced in Middle Stage'. Statement II is incorrect because NEP 2020 emphasizes that mathematics and computational thinking will be given increased emphasis 'throughout the school years, starting with the foundational stage' (not only from preparatory stage).
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I सही है: एनईपी 2020 सिफारिश करता है कि 'कोडिंग से जुड़ी गतिविधियाँ मिडिल स्टेज में शुरू की जाएंगी'। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि एनईपी 2020 रेखांकित करता है कि गणित और कम्प्यूटेशनल सोच पर 'फाउंडेशनल स्टेज (बुनियादी चरण) से शुरू होकर' पूरे स्कूली वर्षों में जोर दिया जाएगा।
key_facts: Thus, mathematics and computational thinking will be given increased emphasis throughout the school years, starting with the foundational stage, through a variety of innovative methods, including the regular use of puzzles and games that make mathematical thinking more enjoyable and engaging. Activities involving coding will be introduced in Middle Stage’.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding policy frameworks and their key AI-related recommendations as outlined in the UNESCO 'State of the Education Report for India 2022':

List I (Policy / Framework)
A. National Education Policy 2020
B. National Digital Education Architecture 2021
C. Responsible AI: Part 1 – Principles for Responsible AI (2021)
D. Responsible AI: Part 2 – Operationalizing Principles for Responsible AI (2021)

List II (Key Strategy / Recommendation)
1. Establish a multidisciplinary advisory body such as a Council for Ethics and Technology
2. Offer targeted training in low-expertise tasks that support the AI value chain, such as data annotation and speech transcription
3. Focus on speech detection and analysis services for learning languages using AI/machine learning
4. Lay down principles including safety and reliability, equality, transparency, and accountability

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the UNESCO State of the Education Report for India 2022: NEP 2020 recommends offering targeted training in low-expertise tasks supporting the AI value chain (A-2). NDEA 2021 emphasizes speech detection and analysis services for learning languages using AI/ML (B-3). Responsible AI Part 1 sets out seven principles including safety, reliability, equality, transparency, etc. (C-4). Responsible AI Part 2 recommends establishing a multidisciplinary advisory body like the Council for Ethics and Technology (D-1).
questions.explanation_hindi: यूनेस्को की स्टेट ऑफ द एजुकेशन रिपोर्ट फॉर इंडिया 2022 के अनुसार: एनईपी 2020 एआई मूल्य श्रृंखला (जैसे डेटा एनोटेशन आदि) का समर्थन करने वाले कार्यों में लक्षित प्रशिक्षण देने की सिफारिश करती है (A-2)। एनडीईए 2021 भाषा सीखने के लिए स्पीच डिटेक्शन और विश्लेषण सेवाओं पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है (B-3)। उत्तरदायी एआई भाग 1 सात सिद्धांतों (सुरक्षा, समानता, पारदर्शिता आदि) की रूपरेखा देता है (C-4)। उत्तरदायी एआई भाग 2 एथिक्स एंड टेक्नोलॉजी काउंसिल जैसे सलाहकार निकाय की स्थापना की सिफारिश करता है (D-1)।
key_facts: Offer targeted training in low-expertise tasks that support the AI value chain, such as data annotation, image classification and speech transcription • Focus on speech detection and analysis services for learning languages using AI/machine learning • Seven recommended principles: • Safety and reliability • Equality • Inclusivity and non-discrimination • Privacy and security • Transparency • Accountability • Protection and reinforcement of positive human values • Establish a multidisciplinary advisory body such as a Council for Ethics and Technology to formulate AI policies and act as a think tank

questions.question_hindi:
यादव और अहमद (2026) द्वारा भारतीय शिक्षा में एआई के लिए प्रस्तावित जोखिम-संवेदनशील शासन मैट्रिक्स (Governance Matrix) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. प्रवेश (Admissions) और स्वचालित ग्रेडिंग (Automated Grading) को उच्च-जोखिम वाले शैक्षिक एआई अनुप्रयोगों के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
2. लर्निंग एनालिटिक्स को मध्यम-जोखिम वाले अनुप्रयोग के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
3. पूरक एआई चैटबॉट्स और ट्यूटर्स को निम्न-जोखिम वाले अनुप्रयोगों के रूप में माना गया है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the risk-sensitive Governance Matrix for AI in Indian education proposed by Yadav and Ahmad (2026):

1. Admissions and automated grading are categorized as high-risk educational AI applications.
2. Learning analytics is classified as a medium-risk application.
3. Supplementary AI chatbots and tutors are classified as lower-risk applications.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All three statements are correct. In their doctrinal legal analysis on governing AI in Indian education, Yadav and Ahmad propose a normative Governance Matrix that treats admissions and automated grading as high risk, learning analytics as medium risk, and supplementary AI chatbots and tutors as lower risk based on the consequences of AI use.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। भारतीय शिक्षा में एआई के शासन पर अपने सैद्धांतिक कानूनी विश्लेषण में, यादव और अहमद एक मानक शासन मैट्रिक्स का प्रस्ताव करते हैं जो एआई के उपयोग के परिणामों के आधार पर प्रवेश और स्वचालित ग्रेडिंग को उच्च जोखिम, लर्निंग एनालिटिक्स को मध्यम जोखिम और पूरक एआई चैटबॉट्स तथा ट्यूटर्स को निम्न जोखिम मानता है।
key_facts: Its proposed Governance Matrix treats admissions and automated grading as high risk, learning analytics as medium risk, and supplementary AI chatbots and tutors as lower risk.

questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding policy documents and their specific recommendations in the UNESCO 'State of the Education Report for India 2022' is NOT correctly matched?
options_english: Responsible AI Part 1 (Principles for Responsible AI) : Protection and reinforcement of positive human values
National Digital Education Architecture 2021 : Establish a National Research Foundation (NRF) to expand research in AI

questions.explanation_english: Option 3 is NOT correctly matched because the establishment of the National Research Foundation (NRF) to expand research in AI is a recommendation of the National Education Policy 2020, not the National Digital Education Architecture (NDEAR) 2021. questions.explanation_hindi: विकल्प 3 सही सुमेलित नहीं है क्योंकि एआई में अनुसंधान का विस्तार करने के लिए नेशनल रिसर्च फाउंडेशन (NRF) की स्थापना की सिफारिश राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 (NEP 2020) द्वारा की गई है, न कि राष्ट्रीय डिजिटल शिक्षा वास्तुकला (NDEAR) 2021 द्वारा। NDEAR 2021 का फोकस डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म, व्यक्तिगत शिक्षण सहायकों, पुन: प्रयोज्य ओपन-सोर्स एआई मॉडल और वाक् पहचान सेवाओं पर है।
key_facts: National Education Policy 2020 (ministry of Education, 2020a) ... Establish a National Research Foundation (NRF) to expand research in AI

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding NITI Aayog's approach document 'Towards Responsible AI for All' (Part 1 – Principles for Responsible AI, February 2021):

Statement I: The World Economic Forum Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution collaborated as the Knowledge partner in developing the approach document.
Statement II: For India, the ethics principles for AI design, development, and deployment are grounded in the fundamental rights afforded to citizens by the Constitution.

Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
options_english: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
questions.explanation_english: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. NITI Aayog's approach paper acknowledged the World Economic Forum Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution as the Knowledge partner and stated explicitly that for India, the AI ethics principles are grounded in the fundamental rights afforded to citizens by the Constitution.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं। नीति आयोग के दृष्टिकोण पत्र में वर्ल्ड इकोनॉमिक फोरम सेंटर फॉर द फोर्थ इंडस्ट्रियल रिवोल्यूशन को नॉलेज पार्टनर के रूप में स्वीकार किया गया और स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया कि भारत के लिए, एआई नैतिकता के सिद्धांत संविधान द्वारा नागरिकों को दिए गए मौलिक अधिकारों पर आधारित हैं।
key_facts: We are pleased to have collaborated with the World Economic Forum Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution as the Knowledge partner in developing the Responsible AI for All approach document. ... questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding the ways AI impacts education as outlined in the Yojana Synopsis (February 2020) on 'Innovation in Education':

List I (Impact Area / Mechanism)
A. Hyper-personalisation
B. Smart assistants
C. Assistance with secondary tasks
D. AI-based analytics

List II (Specific Application / Feature)
1. Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Siri, and Microsoft Cortana
2. Developing student-specific learning profiles and customised environments based on ability
3. Academic research across disciplines and transforming library processes
4. Grading activities, routine paperwork, and logistics-related matters

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english:
According to the Yojana Synopsis (February 2020):
- Firstly, AI-enabled hyper-personalisation helps in developing student specific learning profiles and customised learning environments based on ability, mode, and experience (A-2).
- Secondly, smart assistants include Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Siri, and Microsoft Cortana (B-1).
- Thirdly, AI systems assist educators with secondary tasks such as grading, routine paperwork, and logistics (C-4).
- AI-based analytics can help with academic research across disciplines and transform library processes (D-3).
questions.explanation_hindi:
योजना सिनॉप्सिस (फरवरी 2020) के अनुसार:
- पहला, AI-सक्षम हाइपर-पर्सनलाइज़ेशन क्षमता, सीखने के तरीके और अनुभव के आधार पर छात्र-विशिष्ट शिक्षण प्रोफाइल और अनुकूलित परिवेश विकसित करने में मदद करता है (A-2)।
- दूसरा, स्मार्ट सहायकों में अमेज़ॅन एलेक्सा, गूगल होम, ऐप्पल सिरी और माइक्रोसॉफ्ट कोर्टाना शामिल हैं (B-1)।
- तीसरा, AI प्रणालियाँ शिक्षकों को माध्यमिक कार्यों जैसे ग्रेडिंग, नियमित कागजी कार्रवाई और लॉजिस्टिक्स में सहायता करती हैं (C-4)।
- AI-आधारित एनालिटिक्स विभिन्न विषयों में अकादमिक अनुसंधान और पुस्तकालय प्रक्रियाओं को बदलने में मदद कर सकते हैं (D-3)।
key_facts: Firstly, Al-enabled hyper-personalisation helps in developing student specific learning profiles and in developing customised learning environments based on ability, preferred mode of learning and experience. • Secondly, the use of smart assistants (Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Siri, and Microsoft Cortana) and associated technologies offer significant potential to help students. • Thirdly, AI systems can assist educators with secondary tasks such as grading activities, providing personalised responses to students, handling routine and repetitive paperwork and dealing with logistics-related matters. Al-based analytics can help with academic research within various disciplines and potentially transform library processes and staffing requirements with aim to provide a richer user experience.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the findings and policy recommendations of the ICILS 2023 Compass Brief (No. 31) on Generative AI:

Statement I: In most countries surveyed, fewer than one third of school principals reported having received guidance from educational authorities on generative AI.
Statement II: Across countries and age groups, nearly all principals identified an urgent need for teacher professional learning and student guidance related to generative AI.

Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
options_english: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. The ICILS 2023 Compass Brief explicitly notes: 'In most countries, fewer than one third of principals reported having received guidance from educational authorities, indicating that schools were often navigating these developments without clear policy direction.' Furthermore, it highlights: 'across countries and age groups, nearly all principals identified an urgent need for teacher professional learning and student guidance related to generative AI.'
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। ICILS 2023 कम्पास ब्रीफ में स्पष्ट रूप से उल्लेख किया गया है: 'अधिकांश देशों में, एक-तिहाई से भी कम प्रिंसिपलों ने शैक्षिक प्राधिकरणों से मार्गदर्शन प्राप्त करने की बात कही, जिससे पता चलता है कि स्कूल अक्सर स्पष्ट नीतिगत दिशा के बिना इन घटनाक्रमों का सामना कर रहे थे।' इसके अलावा, यह रेखांकित करता है कि: 'विभिन्न देशों और आयु समूहों में, लगभग सभी प्रिंसिपलों ने जनरेटिव AI से संबंधित शिक्षक व्यावसायिक शिक्षण और छात्र मार्गदर्शन की तत्काल आवश्यकता की पहचान की।'
key_facts: In most countries, fewer than one third of principals reported having received guidance from educational authorities, indicating that schools were often navigating these developments without clear policy direction. Overall, the findings underline that adaptation to generative AI does not occur automatically but depends on leadership capacity, system-level guidance, and targeted support. IMPLICATIONS ▶ System-level guidance is essential: the wide variation in generative AI adoption across and within countries shows that diffusion is uneven and highly context-dependent. Without clear frameworks, schools risk responding in fragmented or inconsistent ways. Educational authorities should provide strategic guidance that clarifies expectations, responsibilities, and boundaries for the use of generative AI in schools, balancing innovation with ethical, legal, and pedagogical safeguards. ▶ Support principals as change agents: principals are not resistant to generative AI but are positioned at the forefront of managing uncertainty. The findings show that school leaders require support to translate emerging technologies into coherent school practices. Strengthening principals’ capacity through guidance, leadership resources, and opportunities to engage with AI tools can help ensure informed decision-making and consistent implementation. ▶ Prioritize professional learning and responsible use: across countries and age groups, nearly all principals iden tified an urgent need for teacher professional learning and student guidance related to generative AI.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the emergence and governance of Generative AI in schools based on ICILS 2023 Compass Brief (No. 31):

1. Generative AI tools such as Large Language Models (LLMs) became widely accessible from late 2022 onward.
2. Schools face a dual challenge of preparing students for an AI-integrated society while determining appropriate conditions and boundaries for AI use within educational settings.
3. The policy brief recommends that educational authorities prioritize replacing teachers' instructional workload with generative AI rather than focusing on critical and reflective use.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the brief specifically emphasizes: 'Emphasizing critical, reflective use, rather than replacement of teachers’ work, can help schools harness potential benefits while managing risks related to quality, equity, and academic integrity.'
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि ब्रीफ में विशेष रूप से जोर दिया गया है: 'शिक्षकों के कार्य को प्रतिस्थापित करने के बजाय आलोचनात्मक, चिंतनशील उपयोग पर जोर देना स्कूलों को गुणवत्ता, समानता और अकादमिक अखंडता से जुड़े जोखिमों का प्रबंधन करते हुए संभावित लाभ उठाने में मदद कर सकता है।'
key_facts: These tools, which became widely accessible from late 2022 onward, can generate text, complete school tasks, and provide information across a wide range of subjects and levels of complexity. Their swift diffusion has brought generative AI into students’ everyday lives and, increasingly, into school contexts, raising fundamental questions about teaching, learning, assessment, and educational governance. For schools, the emergence of generative AI presents a dual challenge. On the one hand, education systems are expected to prepare students for a world in which AI tools are likely to play an important role in further education, work, and civic life. On the other hand, schools are increasingly called upon to consider how, and under what conditions, these tools should be used within educationa... Emphasizing criti cal, reflective use, rather than replacement of teachers’ work, can help schools harness potential benefits while managing risks related to quality, equity, and academic integrity.

Its recommended strategies include developing guidelines for 'responsible AI', identifying AI applications with maximum social impact, and improving access and quality of education using AI.
questions.explanation_hindi: यूनेस्को की स्टेट ऑफ द एजुकेशन रिपोर्ट फॉर इंडिया 2022 के अनुसार, नेशनल स्ट्रेटेजी फॉर आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस 2018 (नीति आयोग) का उद्देश्य 'सामाजिक और समावेशी विकास सुनिश्चित करने के लिए परिवर्तनकारी प्रौद्योगिकियों का लाभ उठाना' था। इसकी अनुशंसित रणनीतियों में 'उत्तरदायी एआई' (responsible AI) के लिए दिशानिर्देश विकसित करना, अधिकतम सामाजिक प्रभाव वाले एआई अनुप्रयोगों की पहचान करना और एआई का उपयोग करके शिक्षा की पहुंच और गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना शामिल है।
key_facts: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2018 (NITI Aayog, 2018) Leveraging transformative technologies to ensure social and inclusive growth • Enhance and empower human capabilities to address the challenges of access, affordability, shortage and inconsistency of skilled expertise using AI • Effectively implement AI initiatives to evolve scalable solutions for emerging economies • Develop a national strategy to build a vibrant AI ecosystem in India • Try to tackle some global challenges from AI’s perspective • Develop guidelines for ‘responsible AI’ • Identify AI applications with maximum social impact • Improve access and quality of education using AI • Promote research in AI • Facilitate the adoption of AI solutions

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the ICILS 2023 Compass Brief No. 31: System-level guidance clarifies expectations, responsibilities, and boundaries balancing innovation with safeguards (A-1); Supporting principals as change agents requires strengthening their capacity to translate technologies into coherent school practices (B-2); Prioritizing professional learning highlights short, modular development emphasizing critical, reflective use rather than replacing teachers' work (C-3); and Generative AI tools became widely accessible from late 2022 onward, generating text and completing school tasks (D-4).
questions.explanation_hindi: ICILS 2023 कंपास ब्रीफ संख्या 31 के अनुसार: प्रणाली-स्तरीय मार्गदर्शन सुरक्षा उपायों के साथ नवाचार को संतुलित करते हुए अपेक्षाओं, जिम्मेदारियों और सीमाओं को स्पष्ट करता है (A-1); परिवर्तन एजेंट के रूप में प्राचार्यों का समर्थन करने के लिए प्रौद्योगिकियों को सुसंगत स्कूल प्रथाओं में अनुवाद करने की क्षमता की आवश्यकता होती है (B-2); व्यावसायिक शिक्षण को प्राथमिकता देने में लघु, मॉड्यूलर विकास पर जोर दिया गया है जो शिक्षकों के काम को बदलने के बजाय महत्वपूर्ण उपयोग पर केंद्रित है (C-3); और जनरेटिव एआई टूल्स 2022 के अंत से व्यापक रूप से सुलभ हो गए, जो पाठ उत्पन्न करने और स्कूल कार्यों को पूरा करने में सक्षम हैं (D-4)।
key_facts: ▶ System-level guidance is essential: ... Educational authorities should provide strategic guidance that clarifies expectations, responsibilities, and boundaries for the use of generative AI in schools, balancing innovation with ethical, legal, and pedagogical safeguards. ▶ Support principals as change agents: ... The findings show that school leaders require support to translate emerging technologies into coherent school practices. Strengthening principals’ capacity through guidance, leadership resources, and opportunities to engage with AI tools can help ensure informed decision-making and consistent implementation. ▶ Prioritize professional learning and responsible use: ... Short, modular, and regularly updated professional development can com plement longer-term curriculum reform. Emphasizing criti cal, reflective use, rather than replacement of teachers’ work, can help schools harness potential benefits while managing risks related to quality, equity, and academic integrity.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding the institutional actions and guidelines for AI in education as outlined in the Ministry of Education's PIB Release (March 2021):

List I (Educational Body / Institution)
A. Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
B. National Council of Educational Research & Training (NCERT)
C. AICTE approved institutions
D. Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs)

List II (Key Action / Recommendation)
1. Suggested to offer AI as an elective in B.Tech courses and launch a B.Tech course in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
2. Initiated the preparation of a new National Curriculum Framework exploring an introductory AI course at the secondary level
3. Introduced AI as a subject in Class IX (session 2019–2020) and Class XI (session 2020–2021)
4. Utilize statutory autonomy to design curriculum and offer advanced AI courses and short-term programmes for working professionals

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english: As per the PIB release (15 March 2021): CBSE introduced AI in Class IX (2019-20) and Class XI (2020-21) [A-3]; NCERT initiated preparation of a new NCF exploring an introductory course on AI at the secondary level [B-2]; AICTE approved institutions were suggested to offer AI as an elective in B.Tech and start B.Tech in AI and Data Science [C-1]; IITs have acts/statutes allowing their own curriculum to offer courses and short-term programmes [D-4]. Thus, the correct sequence is A-3, B-2, C-1, D-4.
questions.explanation_hindi: PIB विज्ञप्ति (15 मार्च 2021) के अनुसार: CBSE ने कक्षा IX (2019-20) और कक्षा XI (2020-21) में AI शुरू किया [A-3]; NCERT ने माध्यमिक स्तर पर परिचयात्मक AI पाठ्यक्रम की संभावना तलाशने हेतु NCF निर्माण प्रक्रिया शुरू की [B-2]; AICTE संस्थानों को बी.टेक में ऐच्छिक और AI एवं डेटा साइंस में बी.टेक शुरू करने का सुझाव दिया गया [C-1]; IITs अपने अधिनियमों और विधियों के तहत पाठ्यक्रम व अल्पकालिक कार्यक्रम संचालित करते हैं [D-4]। अतः सही उत्तर A-3, B-2, C-1, D-4 है।
key_facts: The National Council of Educational Research & Training (NCERT) has initiated the process for preparation of a new National Curriculum Framework for School Education in pursuance of the NEP, 2020 during which the possibility of introducing an introductory course on Artificial Intelligence (AI) at secondary level would also be explored. Meanwhile, the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has introduced Artificial Intelligence as a subject in class IX from session 2019-2020 and in Class-XI from session 2020-2021 in their affiliated schools. All AICTE approved institutions have been suggested to offer Artificial Intelligence as an elective in B.Tech. courses and also start B.Tech course in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science to augment the human resource in Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics. So far as the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) are concerned, t heir Acts and Statutes allow them to have their own curriculum, academic & research collaboration with Institutions and Universities across the world.

2. शिक्षा में AI का नीतिगत विज़न धीरे-धीरे मानव शिक्षकों को पूर्णतः स्वचालित एल्गोरिथम आधारित परीक्षण मशीनों से प्रतिस्थापित करना है।
3. मशीनों और शिक्षकों की सर्वोत्तम विशेषताओं का लाभ उठाकर, आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस का विज़न वह है जहाँ वे छात्रों के लिए सर्वोत्तम परिणाम हेतु मिलकर कार्य करते हैं।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the vision and operational role of Artificial Intelligence in education as stated in the Ministry of Education's official release (PIB, March 2021):

1. AI can drive efficiency, personalization, and streamline administrative tasks to allow teachers the time and freedom to provide understanding and adaptability.
2. The policy vision for AI in education entails gradually replacing human teachers with autonomous algorithmic testing machines.
3. By leveraging the best attributes of machines and teachers, the vision for Artificial Intelligence is one where they work together for the best outcome for students.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the official PIB release, AI can drive efficiency, personalization, and streamline administrative tasks to give teachers time and freedom for understanding and adaptability (Statement 1). The vision is NOT to replace teachers, but rather: 'By leveraging the best attributes of machines and teachers, the vision for Artificial Intelligence is one where they work together for the best outcome for students' (Statement 3). Therefore, statements 1 and 3 are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: PIB की आधिकारिक विज्ञप्ति के अनुसार, AI दक्षता, वैयक्तिकरण को बढ़ावा दे सकता है और प्रशासनिक कार्यों को सरल बना सकता है जिससे शिक्षकों को छात्रों की समझ और अनुकूलनशीलता पर ध्यान देने का समय मिले (कथन 1)। इसका विज़न शिक्षकों को प्रतिस्थापित करना नहीं है, बल्कि 'मशीनों और शिक्षकों की सर्वोत्तम विशेषताओं का उपयोग करके छात्रों के सर्वोत्तम परिणाम हेतु उनका मिलकर कार्य करना' है (कथन 3)। अतः कथन 1 और 3 सही हैं।
key_facts: Artificial Intelligence can drive efficiency, personalization and streamline administrative tasks to allow teachers the time and freedom to provide understanding and adaptability. By leveraging the best attributes of machines and teachers, the vision for Artificial Intelligence is one where they work together for the best outcome for students.

questions.question_hindi:
यूनेस्को की 'स्टेट ऑफ द एजुकेशन रिपोर्ट फॉर इंडिया 2022' में रेखांकित राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 की AI-संबंधी रणनीतियों और सिफारिशों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. यह सभी स्तरों पर छात्रों में महत्वपूर्ण कौशल विकसित करने के लिए AI और डिज़ाइन थिंकिंग जैसे नए विषयों को शुरू करने हेतु पाठ्यक्रम और शिक्षाशास्त्र विकसित करने की सिफारिश करती है।
2. यह सभी भारतीय भाषाओं में पाठ्यपुस्तकों का अनुवाद करने के लिए प्राकृतिक भाषा प्रसंस्करण (NLP) का उपयोग करने की सिफारिश करती है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the specific AI-related strategies and recommendations of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, as highlighted in the UNESCO 'State of the Education Report for India 2022':

1. It recommends developing curricula and pedagogy to introduce new subjects like AI and Design Thinking to develop important skills in students at all levels.
2. It recommends using natural language processing to translate textbooks into all Indian languages.
3. It recommends offering postgraduate and doctorate programmes in AI/machine learning while strictly barring targeted training in low-expertise AI tasks.

Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Under NEP 2020 recommendations documented in the UNESCO report: Statements 1 and 2 are direct recommendations. Statement 3 is incorrect because NEP 2020 specifically recommends 'Offer targeted training in low-expertise tasks that support the AI value chain, such as data annotation, image classification and speech transcription' rather than barring it. Therefore, only statements 1 and 2 are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: यूनेस्को रिपोर्ट में प्रलेखित NEP 2020 की सिफारिशों के अनुसार: कथन 1 और 2 प्रत्यक्ष सिफारिशें हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि NEP 2020 कम विशेषज्ञता वाले कार्यों को प्रतिबंधित करने के बजाय विशेष रूप से 'डेटा एनोटेशन, छवि वर्गीकरण और वाक् प्रतिलेखन जैसे AI मूल्य श्रृंखला का समर्थन करने वाले कम-विशेषज्ञता वाले कार्यों में लक्षित प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करने' की सिफारिश करती है। अतः केवल कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं।
key_facts: • Develop curricula and pedagogy to introduce new subjects like AI and Design Thinking so as to develop important skills in students at all levels • Prepare professionals adept in cutting-edge technologies like AI • Offer postgraduate and doctorate programmes in AI/machine learning • Offer targeted training in low-expertise tasks that support the AI value chain, such as data annotation, image classification and speech transcription • Use natural language processing to translate textbooks into all Indian languages • Establish a National Research Foundation (NRF) to expand research in AI

Match List I with List II regarding key policy documents and their specific recommendations on Artificial Intelligence, as documented in the UNESCO 'State of the Education Report for India 2022':

List I (Policy Document / Framework)
A. Responsible AI: Part 1 – Principles for Responsible AI (NITI Aayog, 2021a)
B. Responsible AI: Part 2 – Operationalizing Principles for Responsible AI (NITI Aayog, 2021b)
C. National Education Policy 2020 (Ministry of Education, 2020a)
D. National Digital Education Architecture 2021 (Ministry of Education, 2021a)

List II (Core Recommendation / Focus Area)
1. Develop a set of reusable AI services, open-source libraries, open-source models, and datasets embedded within building blocks
2. Establish seven recommended principles including safety, reliability, equality, inclusivity, and protection of positive human values
3. Establish a multidisciplinary advisory body such as a Council for Ethics and Technology to formulate AI policies
4. Establish a National Research Foundation (NRF) to expand research in AI

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.explanation_english:

- Responsible AI (Part 2) recommends establishing a multidisciplinary advisory body such as a Council for Ethics and Technology -> B-3.
- NEP 2020 recommends establishing a National Research Foundation (NRF) to expand research in AI -> C-4.

questions.question_english:

1. In the absence of clear frameworks, schools risk responding to generative AI in fragmented or inconsistent ways.
